fills.decision: on the close of the bar ending at the decision minute; entry at the open of the decision-minute bar
fills.target: a resting limit: fills at the target only if a later bar trades through it by at least 1 tick
fills.stop: a resting stop: fills at the stop, or at the bar open if the bar opens beyond it
fills.rounding: targets rounded toward the entry, stops away from it, to the tick grid
fills.flatten: at the open of the flatten-minute bar

luck: matched control: the same entry minutes and bracket distances (target and stop distance from entry), each leg with an independent random direction, simulated on the same bars; 500 draws

name: RTH gap fill
source: classic overnight-gap-fill studies; JJ Simon's gap-fill trades

rule.gap: 08:30 CT open minus the previous session's regular close (same contract)
rule.atr: average true range of the previous 14 sessions (atr_tr_sum / 14)
rule.trade_if: 0.20 x ATR <= |gap| <= 1.00 x ATR (bigger gaps are usually news-driven and continue)
rule.entry: decision at 08:31 on the 08:30 bar's close (still gapped in the same direction, not yet filled); entry at the 08:31 bar open, toward the previous close
rule.stop: entry -/+ |gap| (one gap size against the trade)
rule.exit: target, stop, or flatten at 11:00 CT (early-close days too)
